_comment: Phase -1 cold-start config. JSON (not YAML) so the bootstrap stays stdlib-only. Nothing here is hardcoded in source; edit freely. Secrets (wifi passwords) should ideally live in the OS keychain, not here.

ollama_sources._comment: Per os/arch download manifest for the VERIFIED path. Fill in sha256 to enable a verified install; without it the installer is treated as UNVERIFIED and requires explicit confirmation.
